A sturdy zinc alloy stand with a double-ring design gives strong support, keeping your phone stable in both landscape and portrait and freeing your hands.
The dual-ring magnetic design makes the phone easier to use. It gives steady support while you hold it, take photos or press the Capture button with one hand, and it works well even for small hands.
Powerful magnets snap the MagSafe grip into place with a magnetic strength of up to 1.2 kg, so you can carry your phone on a single finger without worrying about slips or drops.
At a mere 5.9 mm thick the grip slips into your pocket without adding bulk. Placed on a desk it lifts the phone to keep the lenses scratch-free.
The aramid fiber is repurposed from camera ring offcuts, which reduces material use.
